Data:Fee.json.label: Fee
Data:Fee.json.desc: This person's price for a day's work.

Data:Film.json.label: Reel of Film
Data:Film.json.desc: And you thought books were flammable. ['Readable' in only the broadest sense. Find a Projector to play this.]

Data:Finished.json.label: Finished
Data:Finished.json.desc: This is, in one sense at least, complete; concluded; done.

Data:Fire.renounce.brewable.json.label: Renounce (or Brew?)
Data:Fire.renounce.brewable.json.startdescription: If I cast an object into the fire, it will be transformed; destroyed; lost. [If the item is Brewable, add a Soul card to brew it instead of destroying it.]
Data:Fire.renounce.brewable.json.desc: The flames leap up, and die away.

Data:Fire.renounce.correspondence.json.label: Burn Correspondence
Data:Fire.renounce.correspondence.json.startdescription: Perhaps this letter is irritating; or useless; or dangerous.
Data:Fire.renounce.correspondence.json.desc: The flames leap up, and die away.

Data:Fire.renounce.journal.json.label: Renounce What Could Be
Data:Fire.renounce.journal.json.startdescription: Do I really want to burn a book? Do I really want to burn this book? [THIS WILL DESTROY YOUR JOURNAL, which will make it IMPOSSIBLE TO COMPLETE THE GAME. You'll be stuck! But you can do it if you really want.]
Data:Fire.renounce.journal.json.desc: Page by page, my future curls, blackens, disintegrates. Smoke curls thoughtfully, and then the Red Flower thrusts it aside. [It is no longer possible to complete the game.]

Data:Fire.renounce.json.label: Renounce
Data:Fire.renounce.json.startdescription: If I cast an object into the fire, it will be transformed; destroyed; lost. [Use this to dispose of junk, or of danger.]
Data:Fire.renounce.json.desc: The flames leap up, and die away.

Data:Fireplace.ability.surplus.hint.json.label: No need -
Data:Fireplace.ability.surplus.hint.json.startdescription: If I'm only planning to burn something, I won't need a Soul card.

Data:Fivepoundnote.json.label: Five Pound Note
Data:Fivepoundnote.json.desc: 'I promise to pay the Bearer on Demand the Sum of Five Pounds'. The Bearer never does demand, though.

Data:Fixed.json.label: Fixed in Place
Data:Fixed.json.desc: I cannot remove this without applying sufficient force to damage it... and no Librarian of the House would be so crude.

Data:Fleeting.json.label: Fleeting Reminiscence
Data:Fleeting.json.desc: A moment in time. In another moment, it'll be gone. [If unused, Memories disappear with the dawn.]

Data:Floating.island.json.Label: Floating Island
Data:Floating.island.json.Desc: Vanilla, custard, and meringue, landscaped and caramelled: a Claridge's speciality.

Data:Flour.json.Label: Flour
Data:Flour.json.Desc: Pulverised grains, bread's precursor. [Mix with Butter or Milk for Dough; mix with Water for Batter.]

Data:Flushed.mommet.json.Label: Flushed Mommet
Data:Flushed.mommet.json.Desc: A crimson-stained little cloth doll with merry button eyes and a frill of twitching ribbons.

xexts.scrutiny: It's not alive - or not very. It is hungry - but not very. [There are Keeper-level Grail recipes which can develop a Pale Mommet into one of these.]

Data:Foe.carapace.json.label: The Institute's Foe: the Carapace Cross
Data:Foe.carapace.json.desc: The Institute has resolved to guard against the returning Carapace Cross, and the changes that might come.

Data:Foe.chandler.json.label: The Institute's Foe: the Chandler
Data:Foe.chandler.json.desc: The Institute has resolved to guard against the Chandler's coming.

Data:Foe.devourers.json.label: The Institute's Foe: Devourers
Data:Foe.devourers.json.desc: The Institute has resolved to guard first against the perils of the hidden world: alukites, Mansus-spirits, hungry ghosts...

Data:Foe.none.json.label: The Institute's Foe: None
Data:Foe.none.json.desc: The Institute's founders couldn't agree on the nature of the most significant occult threat.

Data:Foe.nowhere.json.label: The Institute's Foe: the Nowhere Hours
Data:Foe.nowhere.json.desc: The Institute has resolved to guard against the all-consuming horror of the gods-from-Nowhere.

Data:Foe.ys.json.label: The Institute's Foe: Ys
Data:Foe.ys.json.desc: The Institute has resolved to guard against the seductions of Ys'

Data:Footstool.grail.json.Label: Inviting Footstool
Data:Footstool.grail.json.Desc: How many home from the storm propped their feet here and gazed into the fire?

xexts.scrutiny: Ambrose Westcott was once lost on the moors. He would not suffer it to be spoken of. Thirza Blake was often lost on the moors. She would not suffer it not to be spoken of.
Put your feet up. The House is yours. Your work might not be done, but you've earned a rest.

Data:Footstool.moon.json.Label: Moon Footstool
Data:Footstool.moon.json.Desc: A soft gold glimmer in the half-light.

xexts.scrutiny: There is a stain half way down the side where, some time in the mid 1830s, Solomon Husher spilt his tea when he heard that Julian Coseley had apologised.

Data:Forbidden.epic.json.Label: Forbidden Epic
Data:Forbidden.epic.json.Desc: 'The attention of the Hours is drawn to the bloodiest wars. Afterwards, the Histories are braided like hair.'

Data:Forge.json.label: Forge
Data:Forge.json.desc: 'Fire', I once read, 'is the winter that warms and the spring that consumes.' [The principle of the Forge transforms and destroys.]

Data:Forge.only.hint.json.label: Now What?
Data:Forge.only.hint.json.startdescription: There's potential here. [Start by adding a Soul card.]

Data:Forgetting.json.label: Forgetting
Data:Forgetting.json.desc: (recipe aspect) - sets memories ready for retirement

Data:Forgetting.persistent.json.label: Very Forgetting
Data:Forgetting.persistent.json.desc: (recipe aspect) - sets all memories ready for retirement, even Persistent ones

Data:Form.order.ch.json.label: Order Form: Cater & Hero
Data:Form.order.ch.json.desc: Cater & Hero has offices almost everywhere. Not in this misty limb of the kingdom - but they will, at least, deliver here. [Use Ink to order items of interest - a few lines on an order form won't consume the Ink. When your delivery arrives, it'll contain a new order form.]

Data:Form.order.trn.json.label: Order Form: T.R.N. Ltd
Data:Form.order.trn.json.desc: T.R.N selects its clients carefully - one might say eccentrically. They rarely advertise. But in all their long history, they have never lacked for custom. [Use Ink to order items of interest - a few lines on an order form won't consume the Ink. When your delivery arrives, it'll contain a new order form.]

Data:Fragrant.chalice.json.Label: Fragrant Chalice
Data:Fragrant.chalice.json.Desc: A glorious globe of wine-coloured flowers.

xexts.scrutiny: When pressed, it's a good source for the intoxicating cordial called rubywise ruin.

Data:Franklin.json.label: Lord Franklin Bancroft
Data:Franklin.json.desc: Rakehell, dilettante, infuriating prodigy. Possibly dead, possibly real.

Data:Fraser.json.label: Mr Fraser Strathcoyne
Data:Fraser.json.desc: Philanthropist, collector, former Librarian. A complicated man, but not a cruel one.

Data:Friend.json.label: Friend
Data:Friend.json.desc: Someone knows you well enough to trust you.

Data:Frithweft.json.Label: Frith-Weft
Data:Frithweft.json.Desc: The 'peace-weaving' for which the Abbey was famous, long before it was named for St Brandan, when it was the Abbey of the Black Dove or the Abbey of the White Crow

xexts.scrutiny: Tease it apart, and hear the distant crackle of old, peace-bound hatreds, twitching to life in the forgotten Histories. [There are Scholar-level Heart recipes that can craft one of these with fabric.]
